torpor' is not restricted in the same way that 'bleed' and'political

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> also, it might be worth noting that the current version of the NRA
> rule does not prevent a minion attempting a 'leave torpor' action,
and
> then the carded 'rapid healing' version of a leave torpor action. in
> fact, they could try again cardlessly if they want, seeing as 'leave
> torpor' is not restricted in the same way that 'bleed' and'political
> action' are.

Change of Target keeps them from attempting the same leave torpor
action, however, so if they try cardlessly then CoT, they can't try
cardlessly again. They could Rapid Healing, though.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"salem" <salem_ch...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:lf3nt0l82bg273afd...@4ax.com...

> also, it might be worth noting that the current version of the NRA
> rule does not prevent a minion attempting a 'leave torpor' action, and
> then the carded 'rapid healing' version of a leave torpor action. in
> fact, they could try again cardlessly if they want, seeing as 'leave
> torpor' is not restricted in the same way that 'bleed' and'political
> action' are.

If you try to leave torpor, get blocked, they don't diablerize, and you
Freak Drive, you can try again cardlessly, for sure. But I don't think
you can if you Change of Target while trying to leave torpor - Change of
Target is more restrictive (can't try the "same action" again) than the
current No Repeat Actions rule. You can try to leave torpor, Change of
Target, Rapid Healing, though, yeah.

Josh
